body:
## Reproduction

1. On a disposable public npm package you own, configure a GitHub Actions trusted publisher for a fork of the template and its `release.yml`. Allow `npm stage publish` only. npm documents this as a supported credential configuration.
2. Add a changeset and exercise the template's automatic release. The GitHub OIDC identity can be exchanged for a package token, so `scripts/preflight-credentials.sh` treats the credential as verified. Its successful-exchange branch checks only that `.token` is a nonempty string.
3. The publisher subsequently uses direct `npm publish`. A stage-only configuration can't authorize that write. This leaves versioning and checks to finish before the workflow reveals the configuration mismatch.

The same preflight decision can be reproduced without credentials by stubbing the GitHub identity response to HTTP 200 with `{"value":"fixture"}` and the npm package exchange to HTTP 200 with `{"token":"fixture"}`, then making the direct publish command return a permission error. The preflight declares success because it has no evidence about the token's allowed actions.

## Workaround

Enable the direct `npm publish` permission on the trusted-publisher configuration for the automatic release workflow, then rerun. Keep stage-only publishers on a staged-release workflow with maintainer approval.

## Suggested change

Clarify that package-token exchange proves the workflow identity and package mapping. It does not prove direct-publish permission. If npm exposes a non-mutating permission probe, check the action the workflow plans to run. Until then, classify direct-publish authorization as unverified at preflight and include the **Allowed actions → npm publish** setting in the publish-time permission error. Add a regression fixture for a successful exchange followed by a rejected direct write. Preserve the existing useful package-mapping check from #207.

- [npm trusted publishing settings and allowed actions](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/)
- [Template preflight at the reviewed revision](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/8e72538d579d904aff818c2447fb3c2413d3a989/scripts/preflight-credentials.sh#L105-L146)
- [Downstream investigation](https://github.com/link-foundation/gh-load-issue/issues/20)
title: npm preflight reports token exchange as verified for stage-only publishers
